content:
maddy: Quick flag 8am monitoring9  validator.soft_coercion spiked on fncall responses. Lots of array->object coercions routing to degen. Why are we silently coercing instead of surfacing?

leo: Which route/model and is this from customer traffic?

maddy: assistant.tools.v2, prod-us-east, redwood-v1-std. Customer sandbox returning items: ["a"] when schema expects items: {name:string}. Validator coerces to avoid adapter hard-failures.

sam: Soft-coercion was added for backward compatibility, but console only shows rejects. We need visibility for soft mutations.

console-bot: Alert: validation.coercion rate x6 in last 2h on assistant.tools.v2. Sample traces attached.

dina: Example payload?

maddy: {"tool_response":{"items":["ok"]}} // interpreted as {"items":{"name":"ok"}} after coercion

amy: That's dangerous. Proposal: (1) expose coercion counts in route UI, (2) add opt-in sampling of raw payloads when coercion occurs (redacted), (3) tag telemetry with coercion_reason for better alerts.

leo: Agreed. Also discuss billing: coerced calls currently billed as successes. Should we flag them in billing export for reconciliation?

sam: Suggestion: keep billing unchanged but add daily billing flag validation_coercion exported per project. Finance can reconcile if needed.

dina: For validation rollout: strict validate toggle needs a canary that surfaces coercion counts + samples. Teams flip strict on and services break silently otherwise.

maddy: Ops alarm idea: if coercions > X% of invokes for 15m create ticket and attach sampled trace.

leo: Implementation notes: emit event validation.coercion from validate_and_normalize() with fields route, model_variant, coercion_type, coercion_reason, trace_id, sampled_payload_id(optional). Sampling <1%, redact by default.

sam: I'll add metric validation.coercion.count with route/model dimensions and sampling hook writing redacted payloads to S3 for opt-in projects.

amy: Console: add a small card to route detail with timeline: Rejects / Coercions / Soft-fallbacks and a toggle to show samples (opt-in + privacy copy).

dina: Owners: dashboard card = me, event emission/schema = @leo, validator & sampling = @sam.

leo: Timeline: event contract PR by EOD Thu, sampling impl by Tue, dashboard prototype Wed.

sam: Follow-up RFC needed to decide if coercions count against graceful-fallback SLOs.

dina: Filing ticket ENG-9123 and adding owners.

maddy: Thanks  ping #eng-platform when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
